title: NVIDIA MGX 1.2 Rack and Tray Interfaces
short_description: Review MGX 1.2 rack, tray, power, and cooling interfaces with CAD motion and 2026 Summit reference-design examples.
overview: Mechanical, electrical, liquid, and module interfaces for deep technical integration reviews, with selected 2026 OCP Global Summit power-reference examples.

modules.title: Rack geometry, datums, and alignment
modules.summary: Trace the mechanical reference chain, datums, tolerances, and interface alignment; distinguish the specification boundary from surrounding power-system context.

modules.title: Tray architecture, board envelopes, and DC-SCM
modules.summary: Interpret hybrid and fanless tray examples, board mounting and keepout rules, and the management-module interface.

modules.title: Modular I/O bay dimensions and retention
modules.summary: Decode bay locations and depth variants, and verify mounting, retention, and fanless interface dimensions.

modules.title: Busbar electrical design and grounding
modules.summary: Locate the 800 VDC-to-low-voltage conversion in the Summit reference design, then apply MGX busbar ratings, grounding variants, insulation, and electrical acceptance conditions.

modules.title: Liquid cooling and blind-mate mechanics
modules.summary: Trace the liquid interfaces and blind-mate mechanics, and use the Summit power-supply/clip example to distinguish component cooling from rack and tray requirements.

modules.title: Load cases, qualification, and integration review
modules.summary: Interpret load cases and qualification evidence, distinguish transient power smoothing from steady-state tests, and assemble a source-linked integration review.

long_description:
Mechanical, electrical, liquid, and module interfaces for deep technical integration reviews, with selected 2026 OCP Global Summit power-reference examples.

**Overall duration: 95 minutes**

**Module 1: Rack geometry, datums, and alignment — 15 minutes.**\
Trace the mechanical reference chain, datums, tolerances, and interface alignment; distinguish the specification boundary from surrounding power-system context.

**Module 2: Tray architecture, board envelopes, and DC-SCM — 15 minutes.**\
Interpret hybrid and fanless tray examples, board mounting and keepout rules, and the management-module interface.

**Module 3: Modular I/O bay dimensions and retention — 15 minutes.**\
Decode bay locations and depth variants, and verify mounting, retention, and fanless interface dimensions.

**Module 4: Busbar electrical design and grounding — 18 minutes.**\
Locate the 800 VDC-to-low-voltage conversion in the Summit reference design, then apply MGX busbar ratings, grounding variants, insulation, and electrical acceptance conditions.

**Module 5: Liquid cooling and blind-mate mechanics — 17 minutes.**\
Trace the liquid interfaces and blind-mate mechanics, and use the Summit power-supply/clip example to distinguish component cooling from rack and tray requirements.

**Module 6: Load cases, qualification, and integration review — 15 minutes.**\
Interpret load cases and qualification evidence, distinguish transient power smoothing from steady-state tests, and assemble a source-linked integration review.
